'''Coronet Times''' was the biggest news agency of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its headquarters were located in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].
